data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 11.6m (2019: favourable development of GBP 15.0m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 9.8m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 2.3m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's prior-year reserve re-estimation shows a net gross adverse movement of c. GBP 21.9m (3.9% of opening gross claims outstanding) driven by adverse movements in a small number of older underwriting years (notably 2016 and 2018) partially offset by releases in other older years. The movement note reports a net favourable development of GBP 11.6m after reinsurance (releases of GBP 9.8m in direct Third Party Liability and GBP 2.3m in Reinsurance), reflecting that reinsurance recoveries materially offset some of the gross deterioration. Management commentary highlights continued reserving prudence (a Management Adjustment) in light of opioids and other pharma exposures and the potential for second-order COVID-related losses.
raw_causal_phrases: a favourable development of GBP 11.6m (2019: favourable development of GBP 15.0m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 9.8m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 2.3m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes

This level of Management Adjustment is considered appropriate in light of the current economic environment, loss exposure on opioids and other pharma losses, and the potential for second order COVID related losses.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross figures) because the Movement in prior year's provision note only reported NET of reinsurance (GBP 11.6m favourable). The gross triangle yields a net gross strengthening of c. GBP 21.9m; the report's movement note reports a net release after reinsurance recoveries. Figures quoted from the movement note (e.g. GBP 9.8m and GBP 2.3m) are net components. Triangle and movement-note perspectives differ due to reinsurance; prior year movement here is taken from the gross triangle and therefore may differ from the narrative NET figure.
